text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Alright, if I can run this well on such a 
grand stage...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This is the power of a Funabashi 
Umamusume! We are by no means inferior!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: Furi-pyon...!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Amazing... You're amazing, Furi-chan!

Even against Central's top contenders, 
Furioso proved she could fight on equal or 
better footing.

Today went splendidly. If she can run like 
this, it'll carry over nicely into next 
year.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Now for the post-race interview. Furioso, 
wonderful job out there.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Good work out there. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Transferring from Funabashi to the JRA, 
don't you feel like you've really hit your 
stride?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Umâjust so there's no misunderstanding, 
please let me explain first.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I haven't transferred out. It's a special 
study abroad program, so my affiliation is 
still with Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi's Umamusume, Furioso! 
Funabashi's Umamusume, Furioso!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Please keep your hopes high for Furioso of 
Funabashi. And be sure to come visit 
Funabashi Racecourse as well.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... That's some incredible hometown 
love...!

Furioso does her best to promote her 
hometown. When suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Then if we could hear about your race 
plans and such for next year—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, next year—
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ah, and you are...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Please don't mind Chan at all~. Chan will 
just stay quietly right here.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Ah... A-Aston Machan-san!? What are you 
doing here...?

I was surprised. The one who suddenly 
popped into the screen was my classmate, 
Aston Machan.

An Umamusume who wants to be a beloved 
mascot. She looks pretty on the outside, 
but...

Her running is quite remarkable. She has 
already won multiple graded stakes in the 
JRA...

She is locked in a battle for the top spot 
with her classmate Vodka, an Umamusume who 
relentlessly pursues coolness.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Why is an ace-class turf runner from the 
Central... all the way here in 
Kawasaki...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Chan-chan, you can't just run off on your 
own! We only came to observe today.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's mostly your fault, Vodka. You took 
your eyes off them because you were too 
busy looking at bikes.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Vodka!? And... Daiwa Scarlet too!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at that! The star players for 
next year's Tiara route are all gathered 
here!

Following Vodka, Daiwa Scarlet—an 
Umamusume obsessed with always being 
number one—also appeared.

The area was instantly engulfed in an 
uproar.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san, Daiwa Scarlet-san, what brings 
you two to Kawasaki Racecourse today?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
All three of you are aiming for next 
spring's Oka Sho, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's correct. Though, of course, 
the one who's gonna win is me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ha, save the talk for your sleep. As long 
as I'm in the race, no one's getting ahead 
of me!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Peace♪

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(This... level of attention... All this 
huge fuss...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (I see. Just as I thought...)

Furioso was watching the sudden, 
unexpected commotion with an earnest 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks to you, I was able to give 
it my absolute all today. But—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
So Central's mainstream is over on the 
"other side," huh.
“The other side.” In other words—
choice_data_list:
Yeah, the turf route is the mainstream 
one.

Yeah, the turf route is the mainstream 
one.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The turf route... Coming from Funabashi, 
that's a path beyond my wildest 
imagination...

Most regional racetracks are not equipped 
with turf courses. Therefore...

For a local Umamusume, that's an 
impossible path. It didn't feel real at 
all, but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"A world I've only ever seen on TV is 
actually right here in front of my 
eyes..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Central is vast and perplexing. Very much 
so...

Even in the midst of all that, though, we 
have to decide on our next target race.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I was able to run in the biggest 
Junior-class dirt race today. So next 
year—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to set my sights on the biggest 
dirt race of the Classic year.

The biggest dirt race of the Classic year. 
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A dirt GⅠ held at Oi in the summer. 
On that once-in-a-lifetime stage—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand as Funabashi's 
representative. No matter what it 
takes...!

"To become the No. 1 Dirt Umamusume of the 
Classic Class. I see our goal for next 
year. However..."

There are many paths leading to the "Japan 
Dirt Derby." I must figure out how to 
navigate the vast URA circuit...
